parole.significato: Name of the first letter of the Arabic alphabet (ا / ا).
parole.testo: From Phoenician 𐤀𐤋𐤐 (ʾlp).

parole.significato: The fifth letter of the Arabic alphabet, called جِيم (jīm) and written in the Arabic script; preceded by ث (ṯ) and foll…
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢄 (l, “gimel”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤂 (l, “gimel”), from an uncertain Egyptian hieroglyph (𓌙?). See also Classical Syriac ܓ (l, “gimel”), Hebrew ג (l, “gimel”), Ancient Greek Γ (G), Latin C and Latin G.

parole.significato: The sixth letter of the Arabic alphabet, called حَاء (ḥāʔ) and written in the Arabic script; preceded by ج (j) and foll…
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢊 (l, “heth”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤇 (l, “heth”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓎛. See also Classical Syriac ܚ (l, “heth”), Hebrew ח (l, “chet”), Ancient Greek Η (Ē), Latin H.

parole.significato: The eighth letter of the Arabic alphabet, called دَال (dāl) and written in the Arabic script; preceded by خ (ḵ) and fol…
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢅 (l, “dalet”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤃 (l, “dalet”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓉿. See also Classical Syriac ܕ (l, “dalet”), Hebrew ד (l, “daleth”), Ancient Greek Δ (D), Latin D.

parole.significato: The tenth letter of the Arabic alphabet, called رَاء (rāʔ) and written in the Arabic script; preceded by ذ (ḏ) and foll…
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢛 (l, “resh”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤓 (l, “resh”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓁶. See also Classical Syriac ܪ (l, “resh”), Hebrew ר (l, “resh”), Ancient Greek Ρ (R), Latin R.

parole.significato: The eleventh letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ر (r) and followed by س (s).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢉 (l, “zayin”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤆 (l, “zayin”), from an uncertain Egyptian hieroglyph (𓈔?,𓏭?). See also Classical Syriac ܙ (l, “zayin”), Hebrew ז (l, “zayin”), Ancient Greek ζ (z), Latin Z.

parole.significato: The fourteenth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ش (š) and followed by ض (ḍ).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢙 (ṣ, “ṣade”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤑 (ṣ, “ṣade”), from an uncertain Egyptian hieroglyph (𓇑?). See also ܨ (ṣ, “ṣade”), צ (ts, “tsadi”), Cyrillic Ц.

parole.significato: The eighteenth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ظ (ẓ) and followed by غ (ḡ).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢗 (ʿ, “ʿayn”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤏 (ʿ, “ʿayn”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓁹. See also Classical Syriac ܥ (ʿ, “ʿe”), Hebrew ע (ʿ, “ʿayin”), Ancient Greek Ο (O), Latin O.

parole.significato: The twentieth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by غ (ḡ) and followed by ق (q).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢘 (p, “pē”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤐 (p, “pē”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓂋. See also Classical Syriac ܦ (p, “pē”), Hebrew פ (p, “pe”), Ancient Greek Π (P), Latin P.

parole.significato: The twenty-first letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ف (f) and followed by ك (k).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢏 (q, “qoph”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤒 (q, “qop”), from an uncertain Egyptian hieroglyph (𓃻?). See also Classical Syriac ܩ (q, “qūp”), Hebrew ק (q, “qūph”), Ancient Greek Ϙ (Q, “qoppa”), Latin Q.

parole.significato: The twenty-second letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ق (q) and followed by ل (l).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢏 (k, “kaph”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤊 (k, “kāp”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓂧. See also Classical Syriac ܟ (k, “kāp”), Hebrew כ (k, “kap”), Ancient Greek Κ (K), Latin K.

parole.significato: The twenty-fourth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ل (l) and followed by ن (n).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢓 (m, “mim”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤌 (m, “mem”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓈖. See also Classical Syriac ܡ (m, “mīm”), Hebrew מ (m, “mem”), Ancient Greek Μ (M), Latin M.

parole.significato: Name of the 24th letter of the Arabic alphabet (م / م), representing the sound /m/.
parole.testo: From Phoenician 𐤌‬𐤌 (m‬m‬ /⁠mēm⁠/). Doublet of ماء (māʔ).

parole.significato: The twenty-fifth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by م (m) and followed by ه (h).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢕 (l, “nun”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤍 (l, “nun”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓆓. See also Classical Syriac ܢ (l, “nun”), Hebrew נ (l, “nun”), Ancient Greek Ν (N), Latin N.

parole.significato: The twenty-sixth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ن (n) and followed by و (w).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢇 (l, “he”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤄 (l, “he”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓀠. See also Classical Syriac ܗ (l, “he”), Hebrew ה (l, “he”), Ancient Greek Ε (E), Latin E.

parole.significato: The twenty-seventh letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ه (h) and followed by ي (y).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢈 (l, “waw”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤅 (l, “waw”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓌉. See also Classical Syriac ܘ (l, “waw”), Hebrew ו (l, “vav”), Ancient Greek Υ (U), Latin F, Latin U, Latin V, Latin W and Latin Y.

parole.significato: The twenty-eighth and last letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by و (w).
parole.testo: From the Nabataean letter 𐢍 (l, “yodh”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤉 (l, “yodh”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓂝. See also Classical Syriac ܝ (l, “yodh”), Hebrew י (l, “yodh”), Ancient Greek Ι (I), Latin I and Latin J.

parole.testo: Ultimately from the Phoenician letter 𐤁 (bet).

parole.significato: The dotless tāʾ is a letter of the Arabic alphabet that was used in ancient Arabic. It is the common archaic form of ت…
parole.testo: Ultimately from the Phoenician letter 𐤕 (t, “taw”).
